name: Vega Insta Glam Dryer
subtitle: 1000W foldable hair dryer with nozzle
description: The Vega Insta Glam VHDH-20 is a 1000W corded hair dryer with two heat and speed settings for everyday drying and basic styling. Its pink and white body includes a foldable handle, detachable concentrator nozzle and overheat cut-out protection for regular home use.
story: Built for convenient daily routines, the Vega Insta Glam VHDH-20 combines a compact body with practical features for home use and travel. The foldable handle helps reduce its storage footprint in drawers and bags, while the detachable concentrator nozzle directs airflow during drying and basic styling. Two heat and speed settings provide simple adjustment options, and the approximately 1.6-metre cord supports use around a dressing area. The dryer runs on corded electric power and is listed with overheat cut-out protection.
shipping: Estimated delivery in around 7 days. Delivery may arrive earlier or take longer depending on your destination and carrier.
